verdict.rationale: Mastra offers an explicit graph-based workflow engine with `.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()` control flow, suspend/resume for human-in-the-loop, and step composition via `createWorkflow`, directly matching branching/loop/parallel needs. However, hands-on community feedback reports the workflow/branching experience feels 'clunky' and awkward to represent graphs, with one user reverting to custom branching logic after frustration.
